events.verdict: Wembanyama (SAS) brings his hands towards McDaniels (MIN) as he releases away, and the contact during the pick is marginal.
Beringer (MIN) and Wembanyama (SAS) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
DiVincenzo (MIN) initiates contact with Johnson's (SAS) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Wembanyama (SAS) brings his hands towards McDaniels (MIN) as he releases away, and the contact during the pick is marginal.

Wembanyama (SAS) moves laterally into Beringer's (MIN) path and initiates illegal body contact after his gather, which affects Beringer's shot attempt. The illegal body contact occurs prior to the contact with the ball.
Johnson (SAS) grasps Randle's (MIN) jersey and immediately releases it, as marginal contact occurs during the pursuit of the rebound.
DiVincenzo (MIN) jumps vertically and absorbs the marginal body contact that occurs with Champagnie (SAS) following the pass.
All technical fouls are reviewed by League Operations.
Fox (SAS) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Edwards' (MIN) arm.
McDaniels (MIN) commits a take foul on Fox (SAS).
Fox (SAS) commits a take foul on Edwards (MIN).
Johnson (SAS) and Randle (MIN) mutually engage and disengage as marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Conley (MIN) commits a take foul on Champagnie (SAS).
Edwards (MIN) commits a take foul on Wembanyama (SAS).
Wembanyama (SAS) enters the lane prior to the ball touching the rim.
